name: carousel-superengine
description: Voice-matched Instagram and LinkedIn carousel engine for coaches — from topic to finished slide images. Run setup once, then generate complete carousels: per-slide copy, design, caption, hashtags, and the actual images (AI-generated in your look, optionally with your trained face; a paste-ready Claude Design prompt; or local PNG/LinkedIn-PDF rendering on Claude Code). Save any finished look as a reusable template and every next build takes minutes. Includes a paste-a-link teardown, a niche-wide competitor synthesis, carousel-from-your-calls, and optional scheduled draft builds (suggest-only; you approve everything). Drafts only — you post. Your config, voice, and templates persist across plugin updates.
